title: Rational Fourier observation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be finite, and let $(x,y)$ be a labeled example with $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$ and $y\in\{−1,1\}$. Its rational Fourier observation on $S$ is $y\prod_{i\in S}x_i$.
